description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Engine Mount Bracket for the RH Side (Passenger) for the G13A & G13BA Engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Right Engine Mount Bracket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
